opportunities.title: Chaosium Just Banned AI Modules — Here's the Monster Reskin Method It Can't Replace
opportunities.why_now: Chaosium's takedown of 40 AI-assisted community titles makes 'is this stat block actually yours' a live question for every GM running homebrew.
opportunities.angle: Quick teardown: take a stock 5e/Shadowdark monster, show the 3 manual tweaks (movement, reaction, loot hook) that make it legally and mechanically yours — no prompt required.

opportunities.title: 'I Shoot the Rope' — The Actual Ruling, Not the Vibe
opportunities.why_now: Gnome Stew's 'Act With Intent' piece is making the rounds arguing GMs should rule on stated intent over literal action; that's a daily ruling problem.
opportunities.angle: One-shot ruling format: a player declares an ambiguous action, show the DC logic and which system (5e vs Shadowdark) actually supports 'intent-first' adjudication out of the box.

opportunities.title: What Shadowdark 'Wants' When a PC Hits 0 HP (And Why 5e Doesn't Want the Same Thing)
opportunities.why_now: Gnomecast 248's 'What the System Wants' framing is exactly the kind of system-design talk that sharpens a quick comparative ruling.
opportunities.angle: Side-by-side: death/dying mechanics across Shadowdark, DCC, and 5e, framed as 'the system is telling you something, stop fighting it.'

opportunities.title: Dragon Kings Reprint Incoming — Here's the Dragon Stat Block Trick 2e Had That 5e Buried
opportunities.why_now: This week's crowdfunding roundup includes a Dragon Kings reprint, giving a timely excuse to dig into old-school dragon design.
opportunities.angle: Creature tactic breakdown: pull one mechanic (fear aura, breath recharge, lair action) from the Dark Sun dragon kings and show how to bolt it onto a 5e/DCC dragon for more table dread.

opportunities.title: OneQuests' New Solo Survival Games Prove You Don't Need a Party to Run a Dungeon Right
opportunities.why_now: OneQuests just launched two solo survival titles, which maps directly onto the 'how do I run tense downtime/survival mechanics' question GMs ask constantly.
opportunities.angle: Mechanical use-case: lift the resource-attrition loop from solo survival design and show how to run a 1-PC Shadowdark/DCC dungeon crawl (rations, light, exhaustion) without a full table.
